current_scope: Secure execution distribution and device/account binding
Telemetry, system health, alerts and incidents
sequencing_rules: Do not jump to implementation while architecture, boundaries, authority, state, failure handling, security, auditability and acceptance criteria are unresolved.
Do not start a later component merely because an earlier component is partially designed or partially built.
Each component must reach zero material findings, closure, freeze and explicit Founder approval before the next component is treated as complete implementation work.
Interface design must express the authoritative system model; interface components must not invent business logic, execution logic, licensing logic or state independently.
Previously hard-locked R5.5 Market Execution Engine logic and security/distribution boundaries remain immutable unless separately versioned and explicitly authorized.
